lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial region, with a primary concentration along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a non-uniform grid pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges on the upper flank characterized by a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral margin, running parallel to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated commensal fish (remoras) clustered near the ventral surface and pectoral fin region.
